name: juez-online
description: Juez online de programación competitiva — taller de microservicios (Arquitectura de Software, UCN)

scripts.infra:reset: sh infra/scripts/compose.sh --profile apps down -v --remove-orphans && sh infra/scripts/compose.sh up -d --wait --wait-timeout 180
scripts.stack:up: sh infra/scripts/gen-jwt-keys.sh && sh infra/scripts/compose.sh --profile apps up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 300
scripts.stack:seed: sh infra/scripts/compose.sh --profile apps exec -T problems node dist/scripts/seed.js
